$comment: Reference corpus for the sidecar transcription quality suite. Each entry is a known-good audio clip plus the text it should produce. The suite (tests/transcription_e2e.rs) is data-driven over this file: add a clip + entry to extend coverage, no code change required. Keep clips small, 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV, and public-domain / permissively licensed (see ../README.md).

fixtures.reference: And so my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
